bio: A contemporary restaurant that stands out for its open-view kitchen and striking wine cellar, with more than 1200 references. The cuisine of Miguel Ángel Mayor, a Barcelona-born chef with Andalucian roots, is centred around two surprise tasting menus (Recuerdos and Influencias) that aim to add a modern perspective to typical Málaga dishes, with a nod to his childhood, while at the same time retaining the full essence of their flavour....
